human_sources.role: The full inner-subgroup characteristic class and trace-modulus classification are the theorem of [ST], Theorem 1.2 and Section 4. The present statement concerns a constant hyperfinite type II-infinite field with a supplied finite orbit exhaustion and does not require ergodicity. Sections 3–5 give the common measurable cochain, trace-gauge orientation and necessity calculations explicitly. The pointwise comparison uses the classical quotient-intertwining construction through the preceding programme lessons.
